svg.title: Aircraft configuration types handled by RISPECT+
svg.desc: Top-view silhouettes of eight aircraft configurations: wingless multirotor, lift plus cruise, vectored thrust, compound helicopter, ducted fan, conventional helicopter, Mars UAV and micro UAV.
